_about: Real world news for each game month, shown in the 'Elsewhere in the World' column of the monthly newspaper (RULES.md §17). Headlines are written in period style and paraphrased from the sources in docs/HISTORY.md. Western Front battles are left out on purpose, because the game makes those happen. Months use the format YYYY-MM.
